Day 4 explore second city. Day 5 return to Denver or maybe depart from Washington? Probably return to Denver. So we need transportation details (flights). Provide approximate flight numbers. Provide restaurant names, attractions.

We just need to call submit_day_plan for each day. Let's craft details.

Breakfast maybe at hotel in Denver before departure, but we can list "Snooze, Denver". Lunch on plane? maybe "In-flight meal". Dinner in Seattle at "The Pink Door, Seattle".
